recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty urban scene featuring three figures in ornate black leather biker gear posed with a motorcycle against a graffiti-covered wall illuminated by a glowing red neon sign.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures in the foreground anchored by a central motorcycle
Neon red glow reflecting off leather and metallic surfaces
Contrast between the sharp yellow block text and the fluid red neon script
Textured graffiti background providing a chaotic urban context
coreInvariants: Heavy black leather textures with metallic studs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame; the central figure is seated on a motorcycle, flanked by two standing figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central motorcycle and the glowing red neon sign directly behind it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright yellow top text, move down to the red neon glow, and follow the diagonal lines of the motorcycle and character poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures, props, and background textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows in the leather and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant neon red providing the primary light source and atmospheric glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary title text and gold for jewelry accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark shadows and saturated red/yellow highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Ultra-bold, rounded sans-serif with tight kerning
Middle text: Monolinear neon-tube style script with connected strokes
Bottom text: Distressed stencil or spray-paint style
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' in the top text contains a small heart or star icon
Neon letters feature extended horizontal connectors to simulate glass tubing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold blocky headers paired with thin, glowing atmospheric script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded geometric feel of the top text
Simulates the monolinear look of the red neon signage

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A gritty urban wall with graffiti and a red neon sign. In front, three men in heavy 80s-style studded leather biker jackets pose with a silver motorcycle. Red lighting should dominate the scene.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold yellow rounded sans-serif text at the top center. Add secondary red neon-style script text across the middle background area.

verificationChecks: Is the red neon glow reflecting on the leather?
Is the top text bright yellow and ultra-bold?
Are the characters wearing heavily studded black leather?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the motorcycle
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is the brightest element
Check that the red light source feels integrated into the scene
Verify the leather jackets have visible metallic details
Confirm the composition follows a central triangular weight
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Biker + Neon Red Glow + Heavy Studded Leather + Bold Yellow Typography
